catalog_evidence.binding: Gateway/direct services use explicit catalog model bindings. AA base names are curated candidates; exact AA variant bindings remain unknown.

notes: The top 20 are all reasoning variants and have no exact score ties. Several variants use the same base model API ID.
Muse Wonder Full has no catalog service binding; its name is not converted into an invented API model ID.
Ranks beyond 20 are preserved for planning. Their mock interfaces and request behavior are not yet covered; top 50 expansion is pending.
Context limits differ between AA and provider service catalogs. Both sources retain their values; no silent reconciliation is applied.
Public initialModels exposes slugs rather than stable AA API UUIDs. No authenticated AA endpoint or inference service was contacted.
